Armed with the S.D. Court Despatch Warrant No.1927
(see diary 2) issued on the 6-4-34, D.S.I. Yang Pei Sheng,
C.D.C.220 and the undersigned proceeded to the S.P.S.
Bureau this A.M. and there at 9.40.a.m. received custody
of the accused Zung Ping Zung.

Upon being interrogated at station, the accused
admitted having taken the described Surtax receipts from Ts
Tseu Kung Ling under the circumstances related on Diary 1,
his companions being : Yang Ah Lai (楊阿来), Loh Tuh Ching
(樂陸慶) and Sung Yue Yoong (孫裕榮), correct addresses
unknown.

He stated that he and the above three men, being the
members of Shipping Hong coolie strikers' Union stationed
at No.5 Peu Kah Loong, Nantao, have been instructed by the
Union to inspect and prevent shipping goods by various
Hongs to Tientsin, and the above action was committed by
them entirely on the orders from the Union. They did not
believe Tseu Kung Ling, the Complt's goods were destined
for Tsingtao, therefore carried away the documents for a
personal by the Union. The accused refused to produce the
stolen receipts stating they are at present in possession
of the said Union, which is headed by one Nyung Shing
Ziang (任兴祥). While in the P.S. Bureau this A.M.
detectives met one named Pao Ting Mao (包庭茂), a member of
the above organisation, who agreed to negotiate with his
colleagues for the return of the documents to Yulin Road.

34年4月7日。

持34年4月6日签发的特别法庭移送令第1927号（见日志2），巡佐杨培生 (Yang Pei Sheng)、刑事侦缉队长220号及下列签署人于今晨前往上海市警察局 (S.P.S.) 办事处，并于上午9时40分在那里接收了被告 Zung Ping Zung（音译）的 custody（监管权）。

在捕房接受讯问时，被告承认在日志1所述情况下，从 Ts Tseu Kung Ling（音译）处拿走了所述的附加税收据，其同伙为：楊阿来 (Yang Ah Lai)、樂陸慶 (Loh Tuh Ching) 和 孫裕榮 (Sung Yue Yoong)，确切住址不详。

他陈述称，他与上述三人均为驻南市裴家弄5号的航运行苦力罢工工会成员，受工会指示检查并阻止各行向天津运送货物，上述行为完全是奉工会之命行事。他们不相信原告方 Ts Tseu Kung Ling 的货物是运往青岛的，因此为了工会私自拿走了文件。被告拒绝交出被盗收据，称目前由该工会持有，该工会由 任兴祥 (Nyung Shing Ziang) 领导。今晨在上海市警察局办事处期间，侦探遇到一名叫 包庭茂 (Pao Ting Mao) 的人，系上述组织成员，他同意与同事协商将文件归还至榆林路。

Station, promising to give an answer at 4.p.m. this inst.
The Complt Wong Tuh Yue further stated that on the
3rd, 4th, and 5th of April 1934, respectively, his Company
had sent their No.1 coolie named Yoong Fah (荣发 ) to the
Union with a request to return the documents which was,
without any explanation, refused by them.
It was also learned from Complt that unless his
Company can obtain the original receipts before they are
able to transport the goods to Tsingtao, they have to pay
$214.50 (value of the receipts) again, as the Government
offices do not issue duplicate receipts.
It was learned by detectives that the described Union
has been formed by shipping hong coolies of the companies
negotiating with Tientsin. The coolies are at present on
strike, over the refusal by their companies to issue them
locomotion allowances.
At 4.p.m. this station was visited by Pao Ting Mae,
stating he was unsuccessful in obtaining the receipts from
the Union. He promised to continue his efforts re recover-
ing them on the 8-4-34.
The accused is charged with "Theft" under Art. 379,
Sect. 4 and will be brought before the S.S.D. Court on
the 9-4-34. A.M. Statement has been taken from him.

捕房，承诺于本月4日下午4时给予答复。
原告 Wong Tuh Yue（音译）进一步陈述，1934年4月3日、4日和5日，他的公司分别派遣其头号苦力 荣发 (Yoong Fah) 前往工会要求归还文件，但均被对方无理由拒绝。
侦探还从原告处获悉，除非他的公司能在将货物运往青岛之前获得原始收据，否则他们必须再次支付214.50美元（即收据面值），因为政府机构不签发收据副本。
侦探获悉，所述工会是由与天津有业务往来的各航运行的苦力组成的。目前苦力们正在罢工，原因是其公司拒绝发放交通津贴。
下午4时，包庭茂 (Pao Ting Mae) 造访本捕房，称未能从工会处取得收据。他承诺将于34年4月8日继续 efforts（努力）追回收据。
被告被控犯有《刑法》第379条第4款规定的“盗窃罪”，并将于34年4月9日上午提解至特别法庭 (S.S.D. Court) 受审。已对其制作笔录。

6-4-34. See below.

On the 6-4-34 A.M. the undersigned submitted an
application for a Despatch Warrant to the S.S.D. Court
for the extradition of the accused from the S.P.S. Bureau,
Nantao.

The Warrant No. 1927, dated 6-4-34 was issued at 3.30
p.m. this inst. and detectives next proceeded to the
S.P.S. Bureau and produced it, when it was learned that the
accused had been released by them this P.M. (6-4-34).
Detectives were explained that following the arrest of the
accused on the 5-4-34, the Kuomintang Headquarters,
stationed in Nantao, made a petition for his release on
the condition that whenever he might be wanted, they
guaranteed him to come forward, to which the P.S. Bureau
agreed and released the man.

Detectives were further informed that he will be
invited to the P.S. Bureau at 9.a.m. on the 7-4-34 and
then handed over to the S.M.P. on the authority of the
above Despatch Warrant.

A visit there at the appointed hour will be made
by detectives.

Statement from Tam Kang Ling, a witness in this
case (see Diary 1), has been taken. The amount of
stolen surtax receipts were ascertained to be $168.4 only.

S. D. 1/6

34年4月6日上午，下列签署人向特别法庭 (S.S.D. Court) 提交申请，请求签发移送令，以便从南市上海市警察局 (S.P.S. Bureau) 引渡被告。

第1927号移送令于本月6日下午3时30分签发，侦探随即前往上海市警察局办事处出示该令，此时获悉被告已于当日下午（34年4月6日）被该局释放。
据解释，在34年4月5日逮捕被告后，驻南市的国民党总部 petition（请愿）要求释放他，条件是一旦需要他时，保证他会出面，上海市警察局同意了这一条件并释放了此人。

侦探还获知，他将于34年4月7日上午9时被邀请至上海市警察局办事处，然后凭上述移送令移交给上海公共租界工部局警务处 (S.M.P.)。

侦探将在指定时间前往那里。

已取本案证人 Tam Kang Ling（音译）的证词（见日志1）。查明被盗附加税收据金额仅为168.4美元。

Remarks.
(Any outstanding or peculiar feature to
be commented on by investigating officer).

At 10 a.m. 5/4/34 the complainant one Yuc
engaged as a clerk at Toong Fah Hoong Shipping Co.,
30 Yoong Bu Fong, Rue Luggage, French Town, and
residing O.O.L. reported here that at about 7.30 p.m.
on the 2/4/34 one named Tseu Kung Ling, clerk of Dah
Toong Transportation Co. 5 The Bund, was unlawfully
deprived of two Government surtax receipts the
property of his, complainant's company, while near
No. 4 Shanghai Cotton Mill, Pingliang Road, by one
Hung Ping Zung and three others.

Inquiries were made by J.S.I. Yang Pei Sheng and
C. .C.420 and the undersigned and the following was
ascertained.

At about 4 p.m. on the 2/4/34 Tseu Kung Ling having
been instructed by his master, proceeded to Toong Fah
Hoong Shipping Co. French Town and there received an
order to deliver a quantity of cotton from No. 4
Shanghai Cotton Mill, Pingliang Road to the above
company to be shipped to Tsingtao on the 3/4/34. On
proceeding to the mill and obtaining the goods he
had received from the management two Government
surtax receipts for $214.50. for same and when about
to depart at 7.30 p.m. 2/4/34 standing on Pingliang
Road, he was suddenly approached by four male
Chinese whom he knew previously by sight. They
enquired as to the destination of the goods. On
receiving the reply from Tseu Kung Ling the goods
were to be shipped to Tsingtao, the first of the
men asked him to show the receipts. Having known
the man before and not suspecting anything wrong,
Tseu Kung Ling had given him the receipts, whereon

34年4月5日上午10时，原告 Yuc（音译），受雇于法租界永福坊30号通发洋行 (Toong Fah Hoong Shipping Co.) 担任职员，居住于 O.O.L.，在此报案称，34年4月2日晚7时30分左右，在大通运输公司 (Dah Toong Transportation Co.) 位于外滩5号的职员 Ts Tseu Kung Ling（音译）于平凉路第四棉纺厂附近，被 Hung Ping Zung（音译）及另外三人非法剥夺了两张属于原告公司的政府附加税收据。

经巡佐杨培生 (Yang Pei Sheng)、刑事侦缉队长420号及下列签署人查询，查明如下情况。

34年4月2日下午4时许，Ts Tseu Kung Ling 奉主人之命，前往法租界通发洋行 (Toong Fah Hoong Shipping Co.)，在那里接到命令，将一批棉花从平凉路第四棉纺厂运至上述公司，以便在34年4月3日装船运往青岛。前往工厂并取得货物后，他从管理层处收到了两张面值为214.50美元的政府附加税收据。34年4月2日晚7时30分许，当他准备离开时，站在平凉路上，突然有四名中国男子走近，他以前见过这些人。他们询问货物的目的地。听到 Ts Tseu Kung Ling 回答货物将运往青岛后，其中第一人要求他出示收据。由于以前认识此人且未起疑心，Ts Tseu Kung Ling 便将收据交给了他，随后

prevent shipping goods to Tientsin by any companies until
their demands were complied with.

调查记录。

那人声称他不相信货物是运往天津的，并宣称他们是航运行苦力罢工委员会的成员，稍后将进行核查，随即将收据放入其口袋。他还告诉 Ts Tseu Kung Ling，如果他的说法属实，他们会将收据送回给他。随后他与同伴登上附近等候的一辆出租车，尽管 Ts Tseu Kung Ling 提出抗议，仍乘车离去。

事发后，原告试图获取收据副本未果，因此将此案提请捕房注意；他希望控告被告，因为没有收据，他的公司无法在任何地方交付货物。

侦探还获悉，上海各航运公司向天津运送货物的许多苦力目前正在罢工，（他们要求发放交通津贴），上述人员是南市航运行苦力罢工工会的成员，他们的任务是阻止任何公司在其要求得到满足之前向天津运送货物。

CRIME REGISTER No:— ........................................Division. ........................................Police Station. ....................................................19 Diary Number:— ........................................Nature of Offence:— | Time at which investigation begun and concluded each day | RECORD OF INVESTIGATION. | Places visited in course of investigation each day | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | | Tsau Kung Ling then located at his company, agreed to accompany detectives and complainant in search for the described men, and on enquiries made the party with the assistance of Nantao Police, located the above Union at No. 5 Lau Kai Loong, Nantao at 12 noon on 4/4/34 where on the indication of Tsau Kung Ling one named Zung Ping Zung 36, /unemployed, Limpo, Siking Road, was taken into custody by detectives, having been identified by them as the man who he had given the receipts to and who actually carried the receipts away.

Upon being questioned he admitted being one of the four men but denied being man who had actually taken away the receipts. He further stated that the receipts were at present in possession of one of the Union leaders, but refused to tell his name and address. The accused was then detained at the Public Safety Bureau the latter notifying the detectives that the accused could be handed over at 5 p.m. 5/4/34 without a despatch warrant.

On visiting them at the latter hour, detectives were refused the extradition of the accused on the ground that they were not in possession of a despatch warrant! Application for same will be made on the 6/4/34 a. m. | |

受审时，他承认是四名男子之一，但否认是实际拿走收据的人。他进一步声称收据目前由一名工会领袖持有，但拒绝透露其姓名和地址。被告随后被拘留于公安局，该局通知侦探，无需引渡令即可于1934年4月5日下午5时移交被告。

侦探于稍后时间前往提人时，以未持有引渡令为由，遭到拒绝移交被告。将于1934年4月6日上午申请引渡令。 | |

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
April MOD 58400
Date 10. 4. 34

Labour

Shipping Hong Workers - Strike Situation

The 80 coolies of the eight shipping hongs
situated in the Settlement and the French Concession
continue to refuse to transport cotton yarn to wharves
as a protest against the abolition by their employers
of the transportation gratuity system.

The person who was arrested by the Chinese
Authorities on a charge of larceny at the instance of
the Municipal Police (Vide I.R. 9/4/34) appeared before
the 1st Special District Court on April 9 when he was
found not guilty but ordered to be detained pending an
appeal by the Municipal Police.

It is reported that the Shipping Hong Workers'
Union will convene a general meeting for April 11 when
a strike of the whole body of the workers in the trade
will be called for. As a consequence, the Bureau of
Social Affairs has decided to issue to-day, April 10, a
notice which will instruct the proprietors of the shipping
hongs concerned in the dispute to maintain the transportation
gratuity system pending a settlement of the trouble, as well
as order the workers not to extend the strike involving at
present only eight shipping hongs to various local concerns
in the trade which number some 100.

Mayar Silk Weaving Factories - strike situation

The strike situation in the ten factories of the
Mayar Silk Weaving Company located in the French Concession
and Chinese territory remains unchanged this morning.

1934年4月 MOD 58400
日期 1934年4月10日

劳工

航运商号工人 - 罢工情况

位于公共租界和法租界的八家航运商号的80名苦力，继续拒绝将棉纱运往码头，以此抗议雇主取消运输赏金制度。

应工部局警务处要求（见1934年4月9日情报报告），由中国当局以盗窃罪逮捕的那名人员，于4月9日出庭第一特区法院。法院判决其无罪，但命令在工部局警务处提出上诉期间予以羁押。

据报，航运商号工人工会将于4月11召开全体大会，届时将号召全行业工人罢工。因此，社会局决定于今日（4月10日）发布通告，指示卷入纠纷的相关航运商号业主在问题解决之前维持运输赏金制度，并命令工人不要将目前仅涉及八家航运商号的罢工扩大到该行业中约100家的其他地方企业。

美亚丝绸织造厂 - 罢工情况

位于法租界和华界的十家美亚丝绸织造公司的工厂，今晨罢工情况依旧，未有变化。
